note: Listing-batch caps the companion enforces server-side. Rust: MAX_PLAN_ITEMS and MIN_PLATINUM in companion/wfm-core/src/plan.rs, MAX_PLATINUM in listing.rs. Browser: prototype/src/lib/limits.ts, which exists only so the UI can reject an out-of-range value before the round-trip. The companion is the source of truth, so drift shows up as the UI cheerfully accepting a batch the companion then rejects - max_platinum was already raised from 999 once, after it silently blocked maxed Arcanes and Galvanized mods that really sell for 1500-2500p.
